mr_title: refactor(router): Avoid unnecessary href updates on navigations for routerlink
mr_description:
The `RouterLink` href does not depend on the state of the router unless
it uses the `fragment` or `queryParams`. This doesn't bother
unsubscribing from the events if the inputs change in a way to no longer
depend on those values since inputs changing is quite rare (and even
more rare for query params handling or preserveFragment to change).

expected_issues.title: RouterLink href not updated after navigation in common configurations
expected_issues.description:
The navigation subscription predicate uses !dependsOnRouterState(defaultQueryParamsHandling) when no explicit handling is supplied. With a default of 'merge' or 'preserve', the anchor therefore stops updating its href when query parameters change.

Explicit 'replace' also skips the subscription, although relative commands can change when the ActivatedRoute changes. The empty-string alias is falsy and does not by itself prove the bug: with an unset default it still subscribes. Keep navigation updates for both query-parameter and relative-route dependencies.
